description: Prior approval for the erection of two new lift shafts to give access from street level to platform level alongside other associated works.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000032(P01), 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000012(P01), 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000010, 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000002(P01), 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000001(P01), 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000031(P01), 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-IMG-EAR-001001 A01, 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-IMG-EAR-001002 A01, 173064-ARC-1700-ISL01-DRG-ECV-001007 A01, 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000011(P01), 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000013(P01), 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000032 (P01), 173064-ARC-1700-ISL01-DRG-ECV-001008 (A01) and 173064-ARC-1600-ISL01-DRG-EAR-000003(P01), received 21/03/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
